record.question: Dampa Tiger Reserve was declared a tiger reserve in:
record.explanation: Answer C: 1994. Dampa was included in Project Tiger in 1994; the question may distinguish sanctuary notification from tiger-reserve declaration. Reference: https://ntca.gov.in/tiger-reserves/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
